Description :
In this episode of Guest in The Newsroom, our guest is legendary actor Pankaj Kapur. Known for his powerful performances in Maqbul, Blue Umbrella, Jane Bhi Do Yaaro, Ek Ruka Hua Failsa, Office Office, KaramChand etc. Pankaj Kapur opens up about his journey as an actor, his philosophy of art, his most iconic roles, and how he approaches them.
